info.name: ContextQA REST — Explicit single-run action
info.description:
Requires a ContextQA account and a scoped REST API token from Settings → API tokens. Signup: https://ship.contextqa.com/ . Store the token privately, never in published values. MCP OAuth is separate: https://mcp.contextqa.com/docs . Limit: 120 requests per minute per token. No live REST validation is claimed for this package.

This GET endpoint starts a billed non-idempotent run. Do not run through a collection runner or schedule. No automatic retry. After an ambiguous timeout, locate the existing run before another attempt. Copy the returned id to the read-only collection runId; do not treat pending as passed.

request.description:
Starts a billed run and returns its id. **Not idempotent**: do not retry after the server may have received the request, or a second run starts. There is no API to stop a run.

Requires permission `TEST_PLAN_EXECUTE`.

Required permission: TEST_PLAN_EXECUTE

exec: if (approval !== 'RUN_ONCE' || !/^\d+$/.test(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('planId') || ''))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set collection planId and execution_approval=RUN_ONCE for one billed run.'); }
